acceptanceCriteria: Concurrent work-item new calls in one repository with the same ID yield exactly one success and one fail-closed result; no duplicate contract or summary and no partial committed pair; concurrent calls in independent repositories both succeed; existing duplicate detection remains fail closed; reservation cleanup preserves retry/recovery semantics; atomic file writes remain used; focused and required repository checks pass; three-language docs describe the duplicate-race boundary.
goal: Introduce a repository-local reservation for Work Item scaffolding that provides exactly-one success under same-repository duplicate races, preserves atomic contract and summary writes, and keeps independent repositories isolated.
intent: Make concurrent work-item new scaffolding fail closed so one repository and one work-item ID produce exactly one committed skeleton.
outOfScope: global locks or global current repository state
Work Item lifecycle semantics outside scaffold creation
